semantic_rule: contract_exists, implementation_exists, test_executable, test_pass and claim_qualified are independent fields. A testdouble PASS never sets production physics claim_qualified=true.

claims.claim: Canonical F-CI11 source and qualification provenance are exact and immutable for F-VQ01.
claims.expected_outcome: PASS only when F-CI11 source is the direct parent of the qualification-evidence commit, workflow evidence names the same source, and F-VQ changes no src/ production files.
claims.scope: Provenance only; does not extend physics qualification.

claims.claim: B1.10 is the exact corrected legacy oracle and its static admission is executable.
claims.expected_outcome: PASS with snapshot B1.10, qualified identity and source manifest 2dfc004f1bae3fc249f384d4f947a07ed4627e83e251ce6557d03092f0b4d1b1.
claims.scope: Corrected-reference identity/admission. Full reconstruction still requires the exact canonical B0 archive.

claims.claim: B1.10 reconstruction is deterministic when supplied the exact canonical B0 archive.
claims.expected_outcome: Produces 63 members, 1,863,575 bytes and manifest SHA-256 2dfc004f1bae3fc249f384d4f947a07ed4627e83e251ce6557d03092f0b4d1b1, otherwise fails closed.
claims.blocker: Exact B0 archive is an external qualified input and is not fabricated by F-VQ CI.
claims.scope: Executable reconstructor exists. F-VQ01 does not claim a fresh reconstruction without the exact B0 archive.

claims.claim: General B2/canonical-reference admission is fail-closed against the F-CI11 source.
claims.expected_outcome: BLOCKED. The gate must not admit B2 while the real canonical physical entrypoint/result contract is unavailable.
claims.blocker: Current candidate record predates F-CI11 and no admitted real execute_reference_interval plus canonical result contract exists.
claims.scope: A blocked gate is the correct F-VQ01 outcome, not a B2 PASS.

claims.claim: Transaction substrate enforces checkpoint, retry, rollback and exactly-one-commit semantics independently of production physics.
claims.expected_outcome: PASS for transaction algorithm/contracts; no SWAP5 physics qualification is implied.

claims.claim: Focused B1.10 physical restore/rerun from the same committed state is qualified for the admitted Hupsel whole-day profile.
claims.expected_outcome: After capture, run, restore and scratch reset, rerun gives zero difference for the qualified state/accounting variables in the admitted whole-day cases.
claims.scope: Focused whole-day Hupsel profile only; not arbitrary optional physics or generic canonical transaction binding.

claims.claim: B1.10 process-continuation capture/restore is qualified for the admitted configured process set and remains fail-closed on configuration mismatch.
claims.expected_outcome: PASS for optional process-state ownership/capture/restore and fail-closed mismatch checks.
claims.scope: Admitted process set. Full generic subday continuation is not inferred.

claims.claim: Canonical b1_10_transaction_model_t execution through the qualified generic advance and mass seam is available.
claims.test_harness: tests/fci/run_fci09_gate.sh plus future F-CI12 binding qualification
claims.expected_outcome: BLOCKED on F-CI11. No SWAP call may be made through the locked generic advance path.
claims.blocker: F-CI12 owns binding of the qualified generic advance and mass seam in b1_10_transaction_model_t.
claims.scope: F-VQ must not implement or bypass the missing production binding.

claims.claim: Same committed-state warm-start independence is qualified on real SWAP5 physics.
claims.expected_outcome: BLOCKED for real physics. Historical synthetic harness PASS is verifier-only.
claims.blocker: No admitted canonical production adapter binds the real B1.10 generic transaction execution. Historical VQ-1e1 uses a synthetic adapter.
claims.scope: Synthetic verifier logic may be rebased later; it cannot qualify physics.

claims.claim: Non-midnight generic physical intervals are executable and mass-conservative for the F-CI11 admitted profile.
claims.test_harness: tests/fci/run_fci11_gate.sh with F-CI11 source-bound generic interval evidence
claims.expected_outcome: PASS for admitted profiles at O0/O2 with hard mass residual <= 1e-6 cm.
claims.scope: Focused F-CI11 physical profile; no universal temporal-error equivalence claim.

claims.claim: Cross-calendar-day generic physical intervals are executable and mass-conservative for the F-CI11 admitted profile.
claims.test_harness: tests/fci/run_fci11_gate.sh with F-CI11 source-bound generic interval evidence
claims.expected_outcome: PASS for admitted cross-day profiles at O0/O2 with hard mass residual <= 1e-6 cm.

claims.claim: Full versus two-half physical split equivalence has a qualified temporal-error metric and tolerance.
claims.test_harness: F-CI11 full-versus-two-half suites plus future temporal-error comparator
claims.expected_outcome: BLOCKED. Trajectories may be compared and mass-gated, but physical differences may not be admitted without a qualified metric/tolerance.
claims.blocker: No qualified physical temporal-error metric or tolerances exist on F-CI11.

claims.claim: Canonical accepted-interval mass accounting uses unrounded numerical quantities for the admitted F-CI11 profile.
claims.expected_outcome: PASS for soil, pond and interception terms in admitted non-snow/non-macropore profile; hard residual <= 1e-6 cm.
claims.scope: Does not qualify complete storage accounting when snow or macropores are active.

claims.claim: Complete SWAP-owned storage accounting is qualified when snow and macropore physics are active.
claims.test_harness: tests/fci/run_fci10_gate.sh plus future optional-storage qualification cases
claims.expected_outcome: BLOCKED and fail-closed when snow or macropore storage is required.
claims.blocker: Complete snow storage accounting and complete macropore storage accounting are absent.
claims.scope: No zero-filled or constructed storage totals are permitted.

claims.claim: Canonical result and transaction-diagnostic output contract is implemented by the real F-CI11 physical entrypoint.
claims.expected_outcome: BLOCKED. Historical semantic contracts may inform rebase but cannot be treated as current production implementation.
claims.blocker: No admitted real canonical result contract is bound to execute_reference_interval on F-CI11.
claims.scope: Historical contract was B1.7-era and requires exact rebase before reuse.

claims.claim: Real B1.10 execution through execute_reference_interval is qualified.
claims.test_harness: tools/vq/b2_reference_gate.py plus future production adapter qualification
claims.blocker: execute_reference_interval is not yet an admitted real B1.10 physical route; F-CI12 transaction-model binding is an upstream dependency.
claims.scope: No legacy route may be relabelled as canonical reference execution.

claims.claim: Legacy backend is fully reentrant and parallel-qualified.
claims.expected_outcome: BLOCKED. No production parallel qualification is inferred from worker-local scratch/capsule ownership.
claims.blocker: Full reentrant/parallel qualification of the legacy backend is absent.
claims.scope: Ownership separation is evidence, not proof of reentrant execution.

claims.claim: O0/O2 numerical identity holds for the admitted F-CI11 physical qualification profile.
claims.expected_outcome: PASS, O0/O2 identical for the admitted qualification profiles.
claims.scope: Compiler/optimization qualification is limited to the recorded GNU Fortran qualification context.
